entries.source: Imported into {0} as "{1}", because you already have a "{2}".
{0} variant(s) came with it; {1} could not be read by this build.
Added the preset "{0}". {1} Select it to apply — nothing changed yet.
This preset is called "{0}", a name the game reserves.
This code defines "{0}", a name the game reserves.
This code is for "{0}", which this build does not have.
This code is neither a variant nor a preset.
This {0} code was written for a different version of the game and cannot be read.
Could not write the variant file.
{0} already ships a variant called "{1}". Rename yours first.
Turn on authoring first — this writes the game's own files.
Only one of your own variants can be promoted.
Could not write the shipped variant file.
Files this session's authoring has written. Worth checking before a checkin.
The base layer every other variant of this category folds over.
A shipped variant. Editing it forks to a copy of your own.
Deletes the persistent change log file.
Deletes the matching preset and any variants it supplies. Categories using one fall back to their base layer.
Deletes this variant's file. Click anything else to cancel.
Delete this variant of your own. Click twice to confirm.
Start a new variant of your own from this one. Type its name in the New row below.
Start a variant of your own from the selected one. Type its name in the New row below.
The variant your changes are written to. Rename it here if it is one of your own.
Showing only "{0}" — click to show the whole category.
Edit this target's values. Your own variants are written in place; a read-only one forks to your own copy on the first change.
Edit the selected variant. A shipped one forks to a copy of your own on the first change.
Paste a share code someone sent you. It lands as a new variant of its own category — nothing of yours is replaced.
This was saved for a different (incompatible) version and can't be applied. Recreate it to update.
This was saved for a different (incompatible) version and can't be applied.
One of your own variants (Saved/AISettings/<Category>). Edits are written straight to it.
Adds a variant of your own to this category, copied from "{0}" (whatever is selected).
Open the AI debug overlay menu. Available only while a game is running.
Every recorded settings change: field, old and new value, and what caused it.
The current selections match no preset. Save them as one to keep them together.
Puts every category back to the settings the game ships with.
A variant supplied by a preset. Read-only: editing it forks to a copy of your own, and it is removed with its preset.
Moves this variant into the game's shipped set under the same name. Your local copy goes with it.
Copies the {0} variant you are editing to a new one of your own.
Saves every category's current selection as one preset.
Search settings — code, name, category, description...
Type at least 2 characters to search.
Copied. The code is in the box above — send it to anyone.
Turns the matching preset into one code, carrying every variant it defines. Copied to the clipboard and shown in the paste box.
Turns this variant into one pasteable code. Copied to the clipboard, and shown below so you can grab it by hand if that failed.
This code is damaged. It was most likely cut short when it was copied — ask for it again.
This code was made by a newer build of the game.
That is not a share code — they start with IRR1-.
